name: playwright-browser-bridge
description: Singleton, loopback-only Playwright MCP companion for exact Post Office browser delivery and collection.

interface.shortDescription: Run the dedicated Post Office browser transport.
interface.longDescription: A Post Office companion that owns one pinned Playwright MCP service and a dedicated persistent Chrome profile. It provides manifest-bound, replay-safe browser delivery and exact attachment collection without granting callers raw browser or CDP authority.
defaultPrompt: Check the Post Office browser bridge.
